reproduction: A source-only export ran the complete test suite and 25 fixed-rule Docker investigations using the pinned local image. Original fixture evidence supported 5 of 5 diagnoses; reduced evidence supported 2 of 5, with no invalid fixture result. Imports were verified inside the export with editable hooks disabled. Existing interpreter/dependency installations were reused; no ignored approval or private reviewer input was required. This was same-machine reproduction, not a new model trial or outside review.
source_revision_note: Verified private implementation commit 9b2f16a282d9933d97182a76eee94925ef06a0ea. Candidate-4 execution uses its separate frozen source identity a5edd835351c37491f4e777b822969e829106b8902e404b398d078f230809da9. Final offline guards, tests, reproduction and publication changes did not replace or rerun its model results.
tests: The combined supported suite passed 608 tests from a source-only export. After final offline setup-guard and report-text corrections, 68 affected tests passed. These groups overlap and are not added together. No test was skipped. The first collection attempt failed on a missing optional dependency search path; that preserved failure was corrected using already installed packages.
